pokedexEntries.la: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

pokedexEntries.sc: It crossed the sea and drifted ashore in a new land. Surviving in this place led it to take on a unique appearance and gain special powers.

pokedexEntries.vi: This special Ursaluna can see in the dark with its left eye and protects itself with mud that is as hard as iron.
